tailoring.headline: eCommerce Success Partner & SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | 5+ years B2B/B2C platforms
tailoring.summary: Seasoned eCommerce technologist with 5+ years delivering SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in building B2B/B2C platforms, integrating product data across PIM, ERP and MDM, and creating headless APIs that drive marketplace performance. Proven ability to translate business goals into technical designs, optimize pricing and promotions, and leverage AI-assisted tools for rapid analysis and documentation. Strong stakeholder management, agile delivery and data-driven growth mindset.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Customer Success Partner – eCommerce EU
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Gore’s ELIXIR Strings mission to bring musicians better strings, and the chance to shape eCommerce growth across Europe. With 5+ years leading SAP Commerce Cloud implementations at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I combine deep platform expertise with a data-driven, customer-centric mindset.

bullets.label: eCommerce Platform Expertise
bullets.text: Delivered end-to-end B2B and B2C SAP Commerce Cloud solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell, driving robust product, pricing and promotion capabilities that underpin marketplace success.

bullets.label: Data & Integration Leadership
bullets.text: Designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris pipelines, API migrations and ERP/MDM integrations, ensuring accurate, timely product data for Amazon and other digital partners.

bullets.label: Business Analysis & Stakeholder Management
bullets.text: Acted as a techno-functional bridge, gathering requirements, writing user stories and functional specs, and aligning technical delivery with business growth objectives.

bullets.label: AI-Driven Efficiency
bullets.text: Leveraged generative AI tools to accelerate analysis, development and documentation, shortening delivery cycles and supporting rapid eCommerce experimentation.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, I hold a valid German work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to ELIXIR’s digital growth.

tailoring.why_company: ELIXIR Strings stands at the intersection of music passion and innovative digital commerce. Gore’s commitment to quality resonates with my own drive to deliver exceptional eCommerce experiences. The role offers the chance to expand ELIXIR’s presence on Amazon, marketplaces and specialty retailers, applying my SAP Commerce expertise to boost visibility, conversion and revenue while supporting musicians worldwide. I am eager to combine my technical background with my love for music to help ELIXIR grow.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to blend my eCommerce expertise with my passion for music, helping ELIXIR Strings expand its digital footprint and deliver better experiences to musicians across Europe.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years driving eCommerce growth for Rockwell and Shell. I’m excited about the Customer Success Partner role at Gore and would love to discuss how I can help ELIXIR’s EU digital expansion.
tailoring.email_body: Dear Hiring Team, please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Customer Success Partner – eCommerce EU position at W.L. Gore & Associates. With over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience delivering B2B/B2C platforms and data integrations for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am ready to drive ELIXIR’s digital growth. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for the role.
